spans.text: Ramtung khat neh khat roeprem cala tukkai na u thae, pomsangna ham la bisai ham a om dong ah khaw tisaeh;

Thlangphun, vuen yong, huta-tungpa, ol, nainganyae poekna, atloetloe poekna, ramtung neh tukkaina, khosak na neh thawtna kong, khuehtawn koeva, khuilam ben neh atloe tloe dong ah paek boe na om boel saeh.

Tecoengah, thlangkhat kho asak nah ramtung tpt khoram khat kah nainganyae dong ah mai a, ukna hmuen dong mai a, ramtung khat neh khat tukkai na dong mai a, thlang khat khosak na hmuen dong ah mai a, ramtung khat te amah ngaihloei ah a uk ram la aom mai a, tpt UNO loh adawndah ramtung la aom mai a, tpt amah poek ah rakthuem ka uk u ramtung la aom mai a, tlam te amah poek ah boeih ka uk u pawh ram la ka om mai a khat neh khat laklo ah paekboe na om boel saeh.

entries.task_id: un|roihui|boeih loh mahkah hamhmoel boeih te khaw
entries.description: UN roihui boeih loh mahkah hamhmoel boeih te khaw
entries.subject: UN
entries.object: boeih loh mahkah hamhmoel boeih te khaw

spans.text: UN roihui boeih loh mahkah hamhmoel boeih te khaw, thlanghing rimom na khaw saeh huta tungpa hamhmoel vanpitna khaw saeh, ka hinyah na ni tila koekthoek ah apom phoei bal ah thlanghing khosak aroeng na neh a aomthen na atang aroeng na ham ol akam coeng dong khaw ti saeh;

UN roihui boeih loh UN neh bongyong u tih thlanghing hamhmoel cina khaw saeh, akungsut yalpona hamhmoel khaw tisaeh, diklai pum ah avaina thai ham tha ka paek ni ti la ol akam coeng dong ah khaw tisaeh:

Ramtom thlanghing hamhmoel cayol he thlangboeih neh buping boeih loh thinkolungbuei ah akhoem doe ah tekah hamhmoel neh yalpona he ahinyah na u hamla ringtuk doe ah tha kahuel uhni tina khaw tiseh; UN roihui cana neh tikah ramtung khui kah khoram kah pilnam boeih loh, tikah hamhmoel na te acoeng thai khui ah bit bit avai thai na hamla ramkhui ramvoel ah tha kahuel uhni tilam khaw tiseh, amaengtaeng tih ramtom thlanghing hamhmoel olhoena cayol te ramtom boeih, thlangtom boeih, vanpit cala abi na u thai ham la, hoe la om.

folded.object: a aomthen na atang aroeng na ham ol akam coeng dong khaw ti saeh

spans.text: UN roihui boeih loh mahkah hamhmoel boeih te khaw, thlanghing rimom na khaw saeh huta tungpa hamhmoel vanpitna khaw saeh, ka hinyah na ni tila koekthoek ah apom phoei bal ah thlanghing khosak aroeng na neh a aomthen na atang aroeng na ham ol akam coeng dong khaw ti saeh;

folded.object: taham paek na so ah oltloek vaengah mai a

spans.text: U ca khaw hamhmoel cana neh taham paek na so ah oltloek vaengah mai a, tholh na so ah laitloek vaeng ah mai a, thlangboeih laithui yung loh khat ben khat bang haa roi mueh la rangpui hmai ah duengtlang cala laithui tih laitloekna te vanpit ca la apang ham om.

folded.id: he thlangboeih|neh|buping boeih loh thinkolungbuei ah akhoem doe ah tekah hamhmoel neh yalpona he ahinyah na u hamla ringtuk doe ah tha kahuel uhni tina khaw tiseh
folded.subject: he thlangboeih
folded.object: buping boeih loh thinkolungbuei ah akhoem doe ah tekah hamhmoel neh yalpona he ahinyah na u hamla ringtuk doe ah tha kahuel uhni tina khaw tiseh

spans.text: Ramtom thlanghing hamhmoel cayol he thlangboeih neh buping boeih loh thinkolungbuei ah akhoem doe ah tekah hamhmoel neh yalpona he ahinyah na u hamla ringtuk doe ah tha kahuel uhni tina khaw tiseh; UN roihui cana neh tikah ramtung khui kah khoram kah pilnam boeih loh, tikah hamhmoel na te acoeng thai khui ah bit bit avai thai na hamla ramkhui ramvoel ah tha kahuel uhni tilam khaw tiseh, amaengtaeng tih ramtom thlanghing hamhmoel olhoena cayol te ramtom boeih, thlangtom boeih, vanpit cala abi na u thai ham la, hoe la om.

folded.object: ramvoel la haekna om mah pawh

spans.text: Mebang thlangkhaw upadi ning mueh la tukna, khohna neh ramvoel la haekna om mah pawh.

folded.subject: khoram khat
folded.object: nainganyae dong ah mai a

spans.text: Tecoengah, thlangkhat kho asak nah ramtung tpt khoram khat kah nainganyae dong ah mai a, ukna hmuen dong mai a, ramtung khat neh khat tukkai na dong mai a, thlang khat khosak na hmuen dong ah mai a, ramtung khat te amah ngaihloei ah a uk ram la aom mai a, tpt UNO loh adawndah ramtung la aom mai a, tpt amah poek ah rakthuem ka uk u ramtung la aom mai a, tlam te amah poek ah boeih ka uk u pawh ram la ka om mai a khat neh khat laklo ah paekboe na om boel saeh.

folded.object: thawtna kong

folded.object: atloe tloe dong ah paek boe na om boel saeh

Thlangtom boeih mah khosakna ramtung lam ka loh, ramtung tloe lam ka loh puen thai na hamhmoel atawn coeng ah mah ramla mael thaina ham hmoel atawn.
Thlangtom boeih hnaemtaekna lam ka loh loeih na ham ramtung tloe ah dingsuek cala raehba thai na hamhmoel atawn.

folded.subject: li vaeng
folded.object: paek tueng dantat na lak ah alen bet dan paek pawt ham

spans.text: Tecoeng ah saitholh li vaeng kah paek tueng dantat na lak ah alen bet dan paek pawt ham.

folded.subject: Nainganyae
folded.object: tukkai mueh saitholh khui long mai a

Thlangtom boeih ngaihloei ah suepsuep tingtun thaina neh buping phueng thaina hamhmoel atawn.

folded.subject: paithai na
folded.object: ngaihloei ah bawk thai na om

spans.text: Thlangtom boeih ngaihloei ah khopoek thai na neh phueng thaina, ngaihloei ah pom tih paithai na neh ngaihloei ah bawk thai na om.

folded.object: kalh saitholh khui long mai a

folded.object: raekra thaina hil ah thum

folded.subject: ramri cina
folded.object: kanghalh mueh la olthangkali neh khopoek nate cangthaina

folded.object: khosa ca la coeng thai

spans.text: Thlangtom boeih ramtung khat kah khosa ca la coeng thai.
Upadi ning mueh la ucakhaw amah ramtung kah khosa ca la coeng na te bawt pa sak thai pawh.
Ramtung tloe kah khosaca tloe la coeng na te khaw hnoel pa thai pawh.

folded.id: ramtung khat|neh|khat roeprem cala tukkai na u thae
folded.subject: Ramtung khat
folded.object: khat roeprem cala tukkai na u thae

spans.text: Ramtung khat neh khat roeprem cala tukkai na u thae, pomsangna ham la bisai ham a om dong ah khaw tisaeh;

Thlangphun, vuen yong, huta-tungpa, ol, nainganyae poekna, atloetloe poekna, ramtung neh tukkaina, khosak na neh thawtna kong, khuehtawn koeva, khuilam ben neh atloe tloe dong ah paek boe na om boel saeh.

Tecoengah, thlangkhat kho asak nah ramtung tpt khoram khat kah nainganyae dong ah mai a, ukna hmuen dong mai a, ramtung khat neh khat tukkai na dong mai a, thlang khat khosak na hmuen dong ah mai a, ramtung khat te amah ngaihloei ah a uk ram la aom mai a, tpt UNO loh adawndah ramtung la aom mai a, tpt amah poek ah rakthuem ka uk u ramtung la aom mai a, tlam te amah poek ah boeih ka uk u pawh ram la ka om mai a khat neh khat laklo ah paekboe na om boel saeh.

folded.id: rhalrih na|neh|khodaeng patang khang na khui lam ka loh loeih tih khosak omthenna diklai phueng na thai ham la
folded.subject: rhalrih na
folded.object: khodaeng patang khang na khui lam ka loh loeih tih khosak omthenna diklai phueng na thai ham la

spans.text: Thlanghing hamhmoel cina bangla nawtsap napawt he thlangtom boeih kah singyoe te aka phaekung ka thae koek khoboe rhamlang la acoeng sak thai dong ah khaw ti saeh, alangya la thuikhan thaina, alangya la bawkthaina, rhalrih na neh khodaeng patang khang na khui lam ka loh loeih tih khosak omthenna diklai phueng na thai ham la, thlangtom boeih loh mah kah ngaihna asang koek la aphong coeng dong ah khaw ti saeh;

folded.id: roepremna roek|kah|a kungpui la a om dong ah khaw ti saeh:
folded.subject: roepremna roek
folded.object: a kungpui la a om dong ah khaw ti saeh:

spans.text: Thlang boeihkah thlangphun rimomna thlangtom vanpitna hamhmoel boeih pompuina tah thlangboeih kah zalpo nah, duengtlangna, roepremna roek kah a kungpui la a om dong ah khaw ti saeh:

folded.id: sak na|neh|imkhuiko pai thai na hamhmoel atawn
folded.subject: sak na
folded.object: imkhuiko pai thai na hamhmoel atawn

spans.text: Kum ka cuep tangtae huta tungpa roek te thlangphun dong mai a, khosaca coeng na dong mai a, bawk na dong mai a paengnael tih pinyen mueh la yuva sak na neh imkhuiko pai thai na hamhmoel atawn.

folded.object: zalpo nah

folded.id: te mah|kah|bawk na tpt oengna te ngaihloei ah puentak thai bueng mueh la amah bueng mai a
folded.subject: te mah
folded.object: bawk na tpt oengna te ngaihloei ah puentak thai bueng mueh la amah bueng mai a

spans.text: Tikah hamhmoel te mah kah bawk na tpt oengna te ngaihloei ah puentak thai bueng mueh la amah bueng mai a, thlangtloe nab bok u tih mai a, rangpui boeih kah hmai ah mai a, ahuep lam mai a, mah kah bawk nate tpt oengna te ngaihloei ah cangpui thai, bawk thai nate ahno thaina hamhmoel thum.

folded.id: te upadi|neh|dawndah paham la angoe dong akhaw tisaeh
folded.subject: te upadi
folded.object: dawndah paham la angoe dong akhaw tisaeh

spans.text: Thlangtom boeih loh atuengta mueh la hnaemtaekna, ukkna, thaekhana na neh ahnukhit ah acoeng thai pawt dong ah lungpok haica neh caemthohna a om na pawt ham, thlanghing hamhmoel na te upadi neh dawndah paham la angoe dong akhaw tisaeh;

folded.id: te|kah|lai thui na ah oeltaih thaina hamhmoel paek tangtae la om
folded.subject: te
folded.object: lai thui na ah oeltaih thaina hamhmoel paek tangtae la om

spans.text: Te bang laithui vaeng ah tholhpael thlang te, te kah lai thui na ah oeltaih thaina hamhmoel paek tangtae la om.

folded.id: tebang rolrakna|neh|thuithet na kui lam ka loh upadi ning la dawndah thai na hamhmoel atawn
folded.subject: tebang rolrakna
folded.object: thuithet na kui lam ka loh upadi ning la dawndah thai na hamhmoel atawn

spans.text: Thlangtom tebang rolrakna neh thuithet na kui lam ka loh upadi ning la dawndah thai na hamhmoel atawn.

folded.id: thaekhana na|neh|ahnukhit ah acoeng thai pawt dong ah lungpok haica neh caemthohna a om na pawt ham
folded.subject: thaekhana na
folded.object: ahnukhit ah acoeng thai pawt dong ah lungpok haica neh caemthohna a om na pawt ham

spans.text: Thlangtom boeih loh atuengta mueh la hnaemtaekna, ukkna, thaekhana na neh ahnukhit ah acoeng thai pawt dong ah lungpok haica neh caemthohna a om na pawt ham, thlanghing hamhmoel na te upadi neh dawndah paham la angoe dong akhaw tisaeh;

folded.subject: thai na
folded.object: phueng thaina

spans.text: Thlangtom boeih ngaihloei ah khopoek thai na neh phueng thaina, ngaihloei ah pom tih paithai na neh ngaihloei ah bawk thai na om.

folded.object: baran kah dawndah na adang ham om

spans.text: Tikah imkhuiko te thlanghing khuiping neh baran kah dawndah na adang ham om.

spans.text: Thlanghing hamhmoel cina bangla nawtsap napawt he thlangtom boeih kah singyoe te aka phaekung ka thae koek khoboe rhamlang la acoeng sak thai dong ah khaw ti saeh, alangya la thuikhan thaina, alangya la bawkthaina, rhalrih na neh khodaeng patang khang na khui lam ka loh loeih tih khosak omthenna diklai phueng na thai ham la, thlangtom boeih loh mah kah ngaihna asang koek la aphong coeng dong ah khaw ti saeh;

folded.id: thlangtom boeih|loh|atuengta mueh la hnaemtaekna
folded.subject: Thlangtom boeih
folded.object: atuengta mueh la hnaemtaekna

spans.text: Thlangtom boeih loh atuengta mueh la hnaemtaekna, ukkna, thaekhana na neh ahnukhit ah acoeng thai pawt dong ah lungpok haica neh caemthohna a om na pawt ham, thlanghing hamhmoel na te upadi neh dawndah paham la angoe dong akhaw tisaeh;

folded.id: thlangtom boeih|loh|mah kah ngaihna asang koek la aphong coeng dong ah khaw ti saeh
folded.subject: thlangtom boeih
folded.object: mah kah ngaihna asang koek la aphong coeng dong ah khaw ti saeh

spans.text: Thlanghing hamhmoel cina bangla nawtsap napawt he thlangtom boeih kah singyoe te aka phaekung ka thae koek khoboe rhamlang la acoeng sak thai dong ah khaw ti saeh, alangya la thuikhan thaina, alangya la bawkthaina, rhalrih na neh khodaeng patang khang na khui lam ka loh loeih tih khosak omthenna diklai phueng na thai ham la, thlangtom boeih loh mah kah ngaihna asang koek la aphong coeng dong ah khaw ti saeh;
Thlang boeih loh thlanghing hamhoel cayol dong kah hnosaithai na neh yalpona hamhmoel boeih he apang ham om.

folded.id: tikah huta|neh|tungpa ayuva roi vaeng a mai a
folded.subject: Tikah huta
folded.object: tungpa ayuva roi vaeng a mai a

spans.text: Tikah huta neh tungpa ayuva roi vaeng a mai a, apaek u roi vaeng amai a, kuttukna, yu loh vasak na neh ka van u hamhmoel te a dang tueng ni.

folded.id: tpt uno|loh|adawndah ramtung la aom mai a
folded.subject: tpt UNO
folded.object: adawndah ramtung la aom mai a

spans.text: Tecoengah, thlangkhat kho asak nah ramtung tpt khoram khat kah nainganyae dong ah mai a, ukna hmuen dong mai a, ramtung khat neh khat tukkai na dong mai a, thlang khat khosak na hmuen dong ah mai a, ramtung khat te amah ngaihloei ah a uk ram la aom mai a, tpt UNO loh adawndah ramtung la aom mai a, tpt amah poek ah rakthuem ka uk u ramtung la aom mai a, tlam te amah poek ah boeih ka uk u pawh ram la ka om mai a khat neh khat laklo ah paekboe na om boel saeh.

folded.id: un|roihui|boeih loh mahkah hamhmoel boeih te khaw
folded.subject: UN
folded.object: boeih loh mahkah hamhmoel boeih te khaw

spans.text: UN roihui boeih loh mahkah hamhmoel boeih te khaw, thlanghing rimom na khaw saeh huta tungpa hamhmoel vanpitna khaw saeh, ka hinyah na ni tila koekthoek ah apom phoei bal ah thlanghing khosak aroeng na neh a aomthen na atang aroeng na ham ol akam coeng dong khaw ti saeh;

UN roihui boeih loh UN neh bongyong u tih thlanghing hamhmoel cina khaw saeh, akungsut yalpona hamhmoel khaw tisaeh, diklai pum ah avaina thai ham tha ka paek ni ti la ol akam coeng dong ah khaw tisaeh:

Ramtom thlanghing hamhmoel cayol he thlangboeih neh buping boeih loh thinkolungbuei ah akhoem doe ah tekah hamhmoel neh yalpona he ahinyah na u hamla ringtuk doe ah tha kahuel uhni tina khaw tiseh; UN roihui cana neh tikah ramtung khui kah khoram kah pilnam boeih loh, tikah hamhmoel na te acoeng thai khui ah bit bit avai thai na hamla ramkhui ramvoel ah tha kahuel uhni tilam khaw tiseh, amaengtaeng tih ramtom thlanghing hamhmoel olhoena cayol te ramtom boeih, thlangtom boeih, vanpit cala abi na u thai ham la, hoe la om.

folded.id: uno|kah|mengteng na
folded.subject: UNO
folded.object: mengteng na

spans.text: Nainganyae neh tukkai mueh saitholh khui long mai a, UNO kah mengteng na, poek na neh kalh saitholh khui long mai a, aka coeng tholh cana dong ah aka soeng tholhpael na so ah aso kah hamhmoel te hno na thai pawh.
